Polishing involves removing the thinnest layer of the clear coat along with imperfections. The layer isn’t unlimited, so we start with a thickness gauge: measuring each panel and calculating how much material is left. If the clear coat is already thin on the roof or fenders, we work more gently or leave the panel untouched.

Next, we use two or three passes: cutting compound removes major defects, while finishing compound eliminates holograms from the machine. We inspect the result under a light that reveals what’s not visible outside. Only after this do we degrease and apply ceramic coating. We polish with Koch-Chemie compounds and apply Gtechniq ceramic coating.

src/content/i18n/services.yaml.33c60d8d96d0193b:
The main value of the film is not the gloss, but the preservation of the factory paint. A repainted fender is visible with any thickness gauge, and during the pre-purchase inspection, it immediately lowers the price. The film absorbs impacts instead of the clear coat: minor scratches self-heal in sunlight, while deep marks remain on the film, not on the body.

We cut the pattern for each specific car using a plotter, and for complex areas — bumpers, mirrors, pillars — we tailor it by hand. Where the panel allows, we tuck the edge inward: this way, the seam doesn’t collect dirt or reveal itself as a thin gray line after a year.

We source our films from XPEL and SunTek. The specific type suitable for your car is determined during the inspection, before you agree to the estimate.

src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.4a0e4d9d8022611c:
Another BMW X5 covered with clear **PPF film**. The film takes on what would otherwise damage the paint: stones, sand, insect stains, and minor scratches that the car accumulates during daily drives. We strongly recommend protecting the headlights as well. Here's what you gain at the front:
  • stones and road debris do not reach the glass
  • no scratches or sandblasting
  • ultraviolet rays are blocked by the film, keeping the plastic from yellowing and clouding over time
  • expensive LED and adaptive optics maintain their factory look
At the rear, the task is simpler:
  • no scratches or minor damage
  • taillights remain clear and shiny for longer
Headlights are one of the most vulnerable areas on a car. Stones, sand, dust, wash brushes, and sun exposure gradually damage the surface of the optics. The film adds an extra layer between them and the plastic, absorbing most of the impact. You can wrap the entire vehicle, just the front, specific body parts, or only the optics.
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.73c62b86675348af:
Još jedan BMW X5 pod prozirnom **PPF folijom**. Folija preuzima na sebe ono što bi inače oštetilo lak: kamenčiće, pesak, tragove insekata i sitne ogrebotine koje automobil doživljava tokom svakodnevne vožnje. Posebno savetujemo da se zaštićuju farovi. Šta to donosi sa prednje strane:
  • kamenčići i putni otpad ne dolaze do stakla
  • nema ogrebotina i peskarenja
  • ultraljubljena svetlost zadržava se folijom, plastika duže ne žuti i ne mutni
  • skupa LED i adaptivna svetla zadržavaju fabrički izgled
Sa zadnje strane, situacija je jednostavnija:
  • nema ogrebotina i sitnih oštećenja
  • lama ostaje prozirna i sjajna duže vreme
Farovi su jedno od najranjivijih mesta na automobilu. Kamenčići, pesak, prašina, četke na car wash-u i sunce iz godine u godinu uništavaju površinu svetala. Folija postavlja dodatni sloj između njih i plastike i apsorbuje najveći deo udarca na sebe. Može se obložiti ceo automobil, samo prednji deo, pojedini delovi karoserije ili samo svetla.

src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.0ff115fa477f316d: Mercedes-Benz GLS - folija sa satinskim finišem
src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.2f29efa1f643d167:
The new Mercedes-Benz GLS 2026 arrived at our studio with two tasks: to protect the body and to change its appearance to a satin finish. Together with the owner, we chose a protective satin film with a thickness of **190 microns**, wrapping the entire body. Under the film, the factory paint remains untouched: minor scratches, stone chips, insect marks, chemicals, and road dirt can no longer reach it. The satin finish transforms how the car reflects light while the original color stays protected beneath the surface. We fold the edges of the parts wherever technically feasible, reducing the number of visible seams, achieving a more cohesive look, and ensuring the film adheres better and lasts longer. The film can be repaired locally. If a specific part gets damaged during use, it is usually unnecessary to replace the entire vehicle; we only change the film on that part. The benefits of complete wrapping include:
  • factory paint doesn’t accumulate chips and minor scratches
  • road dirt and chemicals remain on the film
  • the body is easier to maintain
  • damaged parts can be replaced individually
  • the new car is protected from the very first kilometers
  • the preserved paint is visible when selling
  • satin appearance without repainting
We perform PPF wrapping in Belgrade, in the Zvezdara area. You can wrap both a new car and one that has been on the road: either fully or just the most vulnerable parts. We will select the film option during the inspection. We will present the results of the full satin wrap on the GLS once we complete the project.
src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.f124fec51f69960f:
Novi Mercedes-Benz GLS 2026 stigao je kod nas sa dva zadatka: zaštititi karoseriju i promeniti izgled na satinski. Zajedno sa vlasnikom odabrali smo zaštitnu satinsku foliju debljine **190 mikrona**, kojom prelepljujemo celu karoseriju. Ispod folije fabrička lak boja ostaje netaknuta: sitne ogrebotine, kamenčići, tragovi insekata, hemikalije i putna prljaština više ne dolaze do nje. Satinski finiš menja način na koji se auto vidi na svetlu, dok originalna boja ostaje pod zaštitnim slojem. Ivici delova preklapamo tamo gde je to tehnički moguće: vidljivih ivica je manje, slika deluje celovitije, a premaz se duže drži. Foliju je moguće lokalno popravljati. Ako tokom korišćenja dođe do oštećenja jednog dela, obično nije potrebno prelepljivati ceo automobil — folija se menja samo na tom delu. Šta donosi kompletno prelepljivanje:
  • fabricka lak boja ne skuplja kamenčiće i sitne ogrebotine
  • putna prljaština i hemikalije ostaju na foliji
  • lakše je održavati karoseriju
  • oštećeni deo se prelepljuje odvojeno
  • nova mašina je zaštićena od prvih kilometara
  • očuvana lak boja, koja se vidi prilikom prodaje
  • satinski izgled bez farbanja
Prelepljivanje PPF folijom radimo u Beogradu, na Zvezdari. Može se prelepitii i nova mašina, i ona koja je već bila u upotrebi: cela ili samo najslabije tačke. Opciju folije ćemo odabrati prilikom pregleda. Rezultat kompletnog prelepljivanja GLS satinskom folijom pokažaćemo kada završimo.

src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.7d45f441249e616b:
Toyota Yaris GR Sport naše klijentkinje iz Beograda. Automobil je kupljen polovan, ali u odličnom stanju, i nova vlasnica je odlučila da ne čeka prve gradske oštećenja, već da zaštiti karoseriju odmah.

Yaris je kompaktni automobil idealan za grad, a u gradu karoseriji najviše preti — uske parkinge kod prodavnica i tržnih centara, susedni automobili, nepažljivo otvorena vrata, kolica iz supermarketa, grane i kamenčići sa puta. Najgore je dobiti udubljenje ili ogrebotinu samo zato što je komšija na parkingu otvorio vrata malo šire nego što je trebalo.

Zbog toga je karoserija oblepljena u potpunosti — zaštitnom poliuretanskom folijom debljine **190 mikrona**.

PPF stavlja čvrst proziran sloj na lak i preuzima na sebe sitne ogrebotine, abrazije, tragove lakih kontakata pri parkiranju, prašinu i kamenčiće. Najviše je potrebno zaštiti vrata, blatobrane, branike i retrovizore — oni su stalno u zoni rizika. Dobra prozirna folija pritom gotovo da nije vidljiva — boja, sjaj i izgled karoserije ostaju isti.

PPF ne pretvara automobil u oklopno vozilo i ne štiti od ozbiljnog udarca ili dubokog udubljenja. Međutim, obično gradska oštećenja, koja se tokom par godina kumuliraju i čine lak umornim, uspešno zadržava.

Yaris je otišao u svom fabričkom izdanju, ali sada je karoserija mnogo bolje pripremljena za svakodnevni gradski život.
src/content/works/toyota-yaris-gr-sport/.918eed0479db29d7:
This is a Toyota Yaris GR Sport belonging to our client from Belgrade. The car was purchased used but is in excellent condition, and the new owner decided not to wait for the first city scratches, opting to protect the body right away.

The Yaris is a compact car designed for urban driving, and in the city, the body takes the most hits: tight parking spots at shops and malls, neighboring vehicles, careless door openings, shopping carts from the supermarket, branches, and stones kicked up from the road. It's frustrating to get a dent or chip simply because a neighboring driver opened their door a bit too wide.

That’s why we wrapped the entire body in a protective polyurethane film, measuring **190 microns** thick.

The PPF adds a strong transparent layer to the paint, absorbing minor scratches, scuffs, light parking contact marks, road dust, and stones. This protection is especially needed for doors, fenders, bumpers, and mirrors, as they're constantly at risk. A good transparent film is nearly invisible, allowing the color, shine, and appearance of the vehicle to remain unchanged.

PPF won't turn your car into a tank, and it won't protect against serious impacts or deep dents. However, it effectively shields against common urban damages, which can accumulate over a couple of years and tire the paint.

The Yaris left us in its factory condition, but now the body is much better prepared for the everyday challenges of city life.
